_note: Reference claims written from each paper's abstract (read in the cached PDF text on 2026-11-10). A claim counts as found when one extracted claim matches every pattern in 'facts' (case-insensitive regex, searched in claim + expected_result). Crude on purpose: a model judge replaces it in Article 9.

2310.13548.claim: Five AI assistants show sycophancy across four free-form text-generation tasks
Responses that match a user's views are more likely to be preferred
Humans and preference models sometimes prefer convincing sycophantic responses over correct ones

2408.02442.claim: Format restrictions cause a significant decline in reasoning ability
Stricter format constraints generally cause greater degradation on reasoning tasks
Structured formats such as JSON or XML are compared with free-form responses

2501.10868.claim: Six constrained decoding frameworks are evaluated
Constrained decoding is assessed on efficiency, coverage and output quality

2303.11366.claim: The previous state of the art, GPT-4, reaches 80% on HumanEval
Agents improve through linguistic feedback, not weight updates

2303.17651.claim: Self-Refine improves task performance by about 20% absolute on average
One LLM generates, gives feedback and refines, with no extra training

2302.04761.claim: Toolformer learns which APIs to call, when, and with what arguments
Its tools include a calculator, Q&A system, search engine, translation system and calendar
It improves zero-shot performance and is competitive with much larger models

2210.03629.claim: ReAct beats imitation and reinforcement learning on ALFWorld by 34% absolute success
ReAct beats them on WebShop by 10% absolute success
ReAct interleaves reasoning traces with actions

2201.11903.claim: PaLM 540B prompted with eight chain-of-thought exemplars
It reaches state-of-the-art accuracy on GSM8K, surpassing finetuned GPT-3 with a verifier
Reasoning abilities emerge in sufficiently large models

1706.03762.claim: The Transformer reaches 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German
It reaches 41.8 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-French
The English-to-French model trained for 3.5 days on eight GPUs

2307.03172.claim: Performance degrades when relevant information is in the middle of a long context
Performance is often highest when relevant information is at the beginning or end
The tasks are multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval
